description: This file defines a SettingsProvider class that manages notification settings within a Flutter application, allowing for loading and updating notification preferences with persistence via local storage.

classes.name: SettingsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages notification enabled state, loading from and saving to local preferences.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads notification preference from local storage and updates internal state.

methods.name: setNotificationsEnabled
methods.description: Sets the notification enabled state, notifies listeners, and persists the change to local storage.
